We promise:

Product description:

About this item:
【TRACELESS REMOVABLE DOUBLE-SIDED ADHESIVE TAPE】: Introducing our innovative Traceless Removable Adhesive Tape, your go-to solution for creating photo walls, hanging decorations, and more without the need for nails or screws. This strong, durable adhesive tape is designed for easy application and removal, leaving no residue and causing no damage to your surfaces.
【STRONG ADHESION & EASY TO USE】: Crafted from a new type of PU material, this adhesive tape offers exceptional strength and weight-bearing capacity without the fear of falling. Its waterproof and moisture-proof properties make it suitable for a wide range of applications, including indoor and outdoor use.
【VERSATILE APPLICATIONS】: Whether you're looking to hang picture frames, hooks, door signs, power strips, routers, or decorate your car's interior and exterior, this adhesive tape has you covered. 【SPECIFICATIONS】: Available in sizes 1970mm and 1993mm, with a thickness of either 0.5mm or 1mm, this tape caters to your specific needs. Each pack contains 10 pieces, providing ample supply for multiple projects around your home or office.
【Please note】: Do not remove the sticker on the hand-tear section to maintain the integrity and effectiveness of the tape.
